items.q: How accurate is the audience plan?
items.a: It is a proven starting structure of cold, warm and hot audiences. Real results depend on your offer, creative and tracking, so adjust after a week of data.

items.q: How should I split my budget?
items.a: Give most of it to cold audiences to find new buyers, a smaller share to warm and a small share to hot retargeting. The tool suggests a split for your business.

items.q: Is the Meta Ads targeting planner free?
items.a: Yes. The Meta Ads targeting planner is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Does it need access to my ad account?
items.a: No. It never connects to your Meta account. It only gives you a plan to set up yourself.

items.q: Can you set up and run my Meta ads?
items.a: Yes. Our performance marketing team builds and optimizes campaigns every week.
